subject: MAP draft: approval path, procurement gating, and signature runway
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@stellarsupply.com>; Marissa Lee <marissa.lee@stellarsupply.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: MAP draft: approval path, procurement gating, and signature runway

Hi Alex / Marissa —

Thanks again for the call earlier. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the milestones we discussed and the owners for procurement and legal sign-off. High-level recap:

- Target go-live: internal pilot beginning Jan 18, 2027 (customer-facing rollout dependent on sign-off)
- Target contract signature: Jan 5, 2027 (procurement indicated that signatures before the end of the first week of Jan are necessary to hit pilot start)
- Primary dependencies: SOC 2 evidence, custom IP Addendum review, and PO issuance timelines from procurement

Action items for this week:
1) Please confirm the internal approvers and whether your procurement requires a vendor packet (they mentioned a vendor portal — if yes, tell us the contact so we can submit).
2) Review the attached MAP and SOW v1 and flag any items that need to move earlier or later.
3) If Jan 5 signature is too aggressive, propose the latest acceptable signature date so we can adjust the rollout window and resource bookings on our end.

I copied Vivek (commercial lead) and Rishi (legal ops) so they can comment on the procurement path and potential redline turnaround times. We can set a 30-minute follow-up on Friday if that helps align calendars.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments (2): draft_MAP_20261122.xlsx (MAP milestone sheet, owner columns), SOW_v1_StellarSupply.pdf (SOW draft)
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@stellarsupply.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Lee <marissa.lee@stellarsupply.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft: approval path, procurement gating, and signature runway

Monica —

Thanks for the summary and the MAP. Quick responses inline:

- Procurement: we do require a vendor onboarding packet. I own procurement on our side; I can send the portal contact. Our vendor manager (Dana) will need the SOC 2 report and the standard indemnity questions answered.
- Legal: Marissa will lead our review. Expect ~7–10 business days for initial redlines if there are no major commercial changes.
- Signature runway: Jan 5 is tight given our year-end calendar (holiday closures + leadership travel). If we want to be conservative, Jan 20 would be safer for signature date.

I added our acceptable cutoff above — if Redwood needs to reserve seats or resources earlier, let us know what is required to prioritize procurement on our side.

Alex
Alex Johnson
Director, Product Ops — Stellar Supply Co.
alex.johnson@stellarsupply.com | +1 (617) 555-0890

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@stellarsupply.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T08:33:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft: approval path, procurement gating, and signature runway

Alex / Marissa —

Appreciate the quick feedback. A couple of notes from our side after reviewing procurement requirements:

- SOC 2: we can provide our SOC 2 Type II report and a brief vendor questionnaire within 48 hours of receiving the portal contact. Rishi, please confirm whether we should include any additional attestation for the IP Addendum.
- Redline turnaround: Rishi estimates 5 business days for standard SOW redlines and 7–9 business days if there are commercial changes or if the IP Addendum requires legal review. We will prioritize to hit an accelerated path.
- Resource reservation: Monica, we can provision the pilot capacity with a conditional hold for 6 reserved seats through Jan 10 without additional fees if we have a signed LOI or a committed PO. After Jan 10, resource reservation will be on a best-effort basis.

Can you confirm whether your procurement can accept a provisional PO or LOI to lock the pilot seats? If not, we should move the target signature date to Jan 20 as Alex suggested and update the MAP accordingly.

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Commercial Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T16:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft: approval path, procurement gating, and signature runway

Alex / Marissa —

Thanks — quick legal note after a first read of the SOW and the MAP:

1) IP Addendum: we will prepare a slim addendum that limits the scope to derivative models for customer-provided data; this should be reviewable in 2–3 business days once we confirm the exact clause language you need.
2) Indemnity / Liability: proposing standard mutual indemnity with a $5M cap for product liability; if your legal team requires higher limits, please flag ASAP as that may extend negotiation time.
3) Vendor packet: Monica, once Alex shares the portal contact, I'll coordinate the SOC 2 drop and the questionnaire response.

If Jan 20 is the target signature date, schedule-wise we should aim for completed redlines by Dec 22 to allow approvals and leadership signatures before the holiday window. Otherwise, supply chain/resourcing risks increase.

Happy to jump on a quick call with Marissa and Dana if that accelerates things.

Rishi Malhotra
Legal Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
